# UploadStage

public enum UploadStage

Which step of an upload is running.

## Values

- <span id="f-checking"></span>`Checking = 0` - Asking the service whether it can be reached.
- <span id="f-exportingart"></span>`ExportingArt = 1` - Exporting the art (and models) to a temporary folder.
